# ceph_roles (Data Source)

Lists all Ceph Dashboard RBAC roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ceph_roles" "all" {}

output "role_names" {
  value = [for r in data.ceph_roles.all.roles : r.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) All dashboard roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the role.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `scopes_permissions` (Map of Set of String) Permissions keyed by security scope.
- `system` (Boolean) Whether the role is a built-in system role.
